briefdescription.para: C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ human test reporter member functions.

detaileddescription.para: This source file contains the implementations for reporter_human, the concrete implementation of the reporter abstract interface that presents test results in a human-readable form on the standard output, accumulating output in an internal string buffer and supporting colour-coded diagnostics and multiple verbosity levels.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, since the reporters are internal to the framework.
This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.
